release_notes: Every part type can now say **which brands it applies to** (Admin → Part Types → Add / Edit: *All brands* or a set of brands). The matrix only creates rows for those brands, so a new Samsung-only flex no longer appears under every iPhone, and the models list for a scoped part type shows only its brands. Narrowing a scope later removes the empty rows of the other brands; rows that still hold stock are never touched, and a model you ticked in by hand stays in.; **Shared part types get per-brand default colours.** When a part type covers several brands, each default colour can apply to *all* of them or to chosen brands only (Admin → Part Types → + Add Color). A Samsung model then gets the Samsung defaults and a Xiaomi model the Xiaomi ones — no more union of every brand's colours on every model. The models list shows each model's own defaults, and copying or moving a part type setup carries the per-brand limits along.; Removing a colour (or a model) whose rows already had sales behind them silently left those rows in the matrix forever — they cannot be deleted without losing the history. Such rows are now **hidden** instead: they vanish from the matrix (their history, barcodes and reports stay intact) and come back automatically if the colour is added again.
